key_insight: ENGINE combines low-dimensional zeroth-order updates with high-dimensional corrections to reduce variance without discarding fine-scale information.
engineering_relevance: It transfers variational multiscale ideas from computational mechanics to memory-efficient LLM fine-tuning.
method: Treat low- and high-dimensional parameter spaces as coarse and fine scales.
Use a multigrid-style V-cycle to probe fine-scale information and correct coarse-space sampling.
Analyze variance reduction, curvature-induced bias correction, and convergence under stated assumptions.
evidence_signal: On standard LLM benchmarks, ENGINE reports higher accuracy and faster convergence than existing zeroth-order methods, with up to 2.61× fewer forward passes and no additional peak memory overhead.
watch_item: Theoretical guarantees depend on assumptions, and the abstract does not establish how gains vary across model sizes or tasks.
paper_title: ENGINE: Endogenous Variational MultiScale Optimization for Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-Tuning
